responsibility: Implements the runtime address-grouping facility behind RTentity using a manually allocated binary tree of SYSTEM.ADDRESS nodes protected by an RTco semaphore. It owns initialization, insertion, lookup, deletion, and recursive destruction of Group records, raises fatal runtime diagnostics on internal inconsistencies or duplicate/missing entries, and provides the low-level keyed-address registry consumed by modules like Storage and IOLink-related support code.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the RTentity pair: unlike RTentity.def's abstract Group API, it defines the tree-node structure, binary-tree insertion/lookup/deletion algorithms, semaphore-protected access through RTco, and fatal consistency checks via M2RTS.Halt.
